relations.subject: Jean Philippe Vogel
relations.role: Superintendent of the Punjab, Baluchistan, and Ajmer
relations.evidence: worked with the Archaeological Survey of India from 1901 to 1914 [...] Vogel worked as Superintendent of the Punjab, Baluchistan, and Ajmer based at Lahore from January 1901 to 1914.

relations.subject: Jean Philippe Vogel
relations.evidence: and later, as Professor in the University of Leiden.

relations.subject: Jean Philippe Vogel
relations.evidence: Along with John Hutchison, Vogel authored the two-volume History of the Punjab Hill States (1933). Earlier, these two had also co-authored History of the Jammu State (1921).

relations.subject: Jean Philippe Vogel
relations.evidence: In the early twentieth century, Vogel helped establish the Bhuri Singh Museum in the Chamba state.
